title: Real integration, activation and rollback

tests.name: node scripts/verify-release.mjs
tests.detail: PASS: 8 required gates and 2 optional gates, all executed. 104 tests, 103 pass, 1 skipped, 0 fail.

findings: Every gate runs a command and reads its exit status. A gate that cannot run reports blocked_environment and is never counted as a pass.
doctor reports the active engine, the vendored pins with their patch revisions, and whether the build is present; it probes the external CLIs only in legacy mode, where they are actually used.
Rollback is one environment variable and is asserted by a gate.
knownLimitations: The unified reader is not the default. Flipping it is a separate release decision.
Not exercised: installing lazy-intel into a real OMP host in unified mode, and multi-root operation. Both need a host this session did not drive.
Language coverage is claimed only for python and typescript semantics and for javascript/typescript/python parser convergence.
rollback: Unset LAZY_INTEL_ENGINE and restart. Derived indexes and their leases are shared by both readers and need no downgrade.
